book.name: 1 TESALONIKA
book.title: SURANA PAUL MOBHAA-BHAANA TO JAMAʼA I TESALONIKA

content: Naasehati mamudhaakana Tadhadhi Mangkilo

E manga witinaiku, aahirina ingkami taemani tee tanaasehatiakakomiu i nuncana sarona Isa Oputa Momalanga mboomo mopadhana ipengkaadhariakamiu tuaapa o carana tabeana udhadhi mamudhaakana umembali upasanaa incana Aulataʼala. Maka sii-sii tee kuasana Isa Oputa Momalanga ingkami tajungkurikomiu mamudhaakana uhanda mpuu upewau giu incia sumai,
roonamo umataua o kasamea mopadhana idhawuakamami to ingkomiu minaaka i Isa Oputa Momalanga.
Giumo incia sii o kapeeluana Aulataʼala: Dhadhi mangkilomo, siitumo upekaridhoa o karomiu minaaka i pewau pebula,
mamudhaakana bhari-bharikomiu umataua tuaapa o carana ukuasai karomiu,
tee mboo sumai ingkomiu udhadhi mangkilo tee ahoromatikomiu maanusia rangamiu,
bholi uose nawusuumiu, mboomo manga mia inda momatauna Aulataʼala.

I nuncana giu incia sii, bholi dhaangia mopekarugina tee moʼakalaina witinaina saʼiimani. Maʼanana ancosala dhaangia mopewauna zinaa tee bhawinena witinaina mosaʼiimani. Minaaka i piamo itu ingkami padhamo taudhaniakakomiu, ande o Kawasana Opu dhaanamo bheahukumu manga mia mopewauna kasalaha mboo sumai.
Aulataʼala mangakemba mencuana to tapewau manga giu marombu, maka to tapewauaka giu mangkilo.
Rampaakanamo sumai, ande dhaangia o mia momendeuna kaadhari incia sii, sumaimo mencuana amendeu aose maanusia, maka amendeu aose Aulataʼala mopadhana modhawuakakomiu Rohina Momangkilo.
Ingkami indamo afaraluu to taburiakakomiu carana tuaapa umaasiaka manga witinaimiu saʼiimani, roonamo carana upomaamaasiaka podho-podho ingkomiu padhamo upengkaadhariakea minaaka i Aulataʼala.
E manga witinai, giu incia sumai padhamo upewaua to bhari-bharia witinaita saʼiimani i Makedonia, maka ingkami taudhaniakakomiu mpuu mamudhaakana uhanda upomaamaasiaka.

Giu molaengana to ropeamiu satotuuna udhadhi utanangi tee inda uʼurusu masaʼalana mia mosagaanana, tee upeelomo karajaa to upadhadhiaka karomiu, mboomo mopadhana iparintaakamami to ingkomiu i piamo itu.
Tee udhadhi mboo sumai, ingkomiu inda uposaronaka i incemapo uka, tee manga mia inda moparacaeana tee Al Masi bheahoromatikomiu.
Umbaana Kawasana Opu
E manga witinai, ingkami gaumami umataua o kadhaangiana mia mate, mamudhaakana inda amapii incamiu mboomo mia inda tee iharapuna.

Ingkita taparacaea ande o Isa amatemo tee adhadhimo pendua. Rampaakanamo sumai ingkita uka taparacaea ande o Aulataʼala bheapadhadhi pendua bhari-bharia mia moparacaeana tee Al Masi tee bheadhadhi apobhawa tee Isa.
Pogau ibhoasakamami to ingkomiu sii alaloi firimanina Kawasana Opu, siitumo: Wakutuuna umbaana Isa Al Masi, ingkita modhadhina sii inda bhetaporikanaaka manga mia moporikanana momate.

Naile itu o Isa Oputa Momalanga bheasapo minaaka i sorogaa apoose adhawuaka parinta tee suara momakaa, apoose tee suarana kapalana malaaʼekati tee uka onina sangkakalana Aulataʼala. Manga mia mate moposaanguna tee Al Masi siitumo bhemobhaa-bhaana bheipadhadhi pendua,

kasiimpo o bhilaana manga mia modhadhina i wakutuu incia sumai bheapobhawa-bhawa atoangka i bhawona taʼina ngalu tee manga mia moparacaeana tee Al Masi mopadhana ipadhadhi pendua minaaka i mate to apokawa tee Kawasana Opu i laiana. Mboomo sumai ingkita bhetapobhawa-bhawa tee Kawasana Opu saʼumurua.
Rampaakanamo sumai, ingkomiu tabeana upopekaoge inca podho-podho ingkomiu tee bhoasaka incia sii.

footnotes.text: ukuasai karomiu: Pogau mokomaʼanana 'karo' amembali uka akomaʼana 'bhawinena,' sabutuna aeati incia sii amembali atomaʼanai, "Aulataʼala gauna uka samia-samia umane mokobhawine tabeana amataua tuaapa adhadhi aposaangu tee bhawinena tee cara momangkilo tee motohoromati i aroana bhari-bharia mia."
